name: Loughor RFC
subtitle: Members' card and club news
promotional_text: Your Loughor RFC membership card on your phone, Apple Watch and in Apple Wallet, with club news and match-day notices the moment they go out.
description:
The official members' app of Loughor RFC, the Blues, est. 1882.

Your membership card lives on your phone and your watch. At the bar, hold your phone or watch near the reader, or show the QR code, and your members' discount is applied every time, with no card to carry or lose.

• Tap to show your card: on Android phones and Wear OS watches with NFC, hold it near the reader
• Your card's QR code for any till, with the screen turned up so it scans first time
• Members' discount on every visit
• See what you have spent, earned and saved
• Club news, fixtures and offers, sent straight to your phone as notifications
• Add your card to Apple Wallet
• Your card on your Apple Watch

On iPhone and Apple Watch, show your card's QR code at the bar (from the app or Apple Wallet).

Sign in with Apple, Google, your phone, a passkey, or your email address with a one-time code or a password. The app is for club members: if you are not a member yet, ask at the club.

review.notes: Loughor RFC's members' app. Sign-in is for club members only: use the reviewer account in Sign-In Information (email and password). Once signed in: Card shows the member's QR code for the till and Add to Apple Wallet; Activity lists points earned and spent; the bell at the top right opens club news; Venue has the notifications switch; Account has the member's details, sign-out and account deletion. Notifications are sent by the club from its back office, so none may arrive during review. The app sells no digital goods.

testflight.description: The Loughor RFC members' app: the membership card with its QR code for the till, Add to Apple Wallet, club news and notifications, and the card on Apple Watch.
testflight.what_to_test: First build: sign in, show the card's QR code, add it to Apple Wallet, open club news, and open the card on Apple Watch.
